title: Two crews, one relay
text: Split into Team Alpha and Team Beta. Each crew cracks five-letter access codes. Three codes takes the relay.

title: Send three clues
text: Everyone gets a secret word at the same time and types three one-word clues for their own crew.

title: The other crew jams one
text: Then everyone jams at once: you swap one clue of a player on the other crew for a fake.

title: Guess out loud, then crack the code
text: Crews take turns guessing each word out loud. Right? Reveal one letter of your code, or risk it and guess all five.

title: Signal lost
text: Miss, and the other crew decodes a letter instead. First crew to crack three codes takes the relay!
